name: yf_trending_tickers
description:
Tickers trending on Yahoo Finance for a region (Yahoo's trending endpoint, which needs no cookie).
Returns: {region, count, symbols: ["ASML", "JPM", ...]} in Yahoo's order, or {region, error}; symbols only, so quote them with yahoo_get_quote or yf_compare_stocks.
Inputs (* required): region (two letters, e.g. US, GB, IN; default US); limit (symbols, 1-50; default 20).
Most traded rather than most viewed: yf_screener with most_actives.
Example: {"region": "US", "limit": 10}

region.description: Two-letter Yahoo region, e.g. US, GB, IN, DE
